name: cognito-forms
label: Cognito Forms
description: Online form builder for collecting and managing submissions.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
1. Sign in to Cognito Forms as an organization owner or admin.
2. Click your organization's name in the top left corner, then click **Settings**.
3. Open **Integrations** and click **+ New API Key**.
4. Give the key the scopes you need (**Read** to look up forms and entries, **Write** to create or update entries, **Delete** to delete entries) and access to the forms you want to use.
5. Copy the key and paste it here. Cognito Forms only shows it once.

The Cognito Forms API needs a paid plan.

create_entry.label: Create Entry
create_entry.description: Creates a new entry in a form.

formId.label: Form
formId.description: Pick the form. Only forms the API key has access to are listed.

get_entry.label: Get Entry
get_entry.description: Gets an entry by its number or ID.

formId.label: Form
formId.description: Pick the form. Only forms the API key has access to are listed.

entryId.label: Entry ID
entryId.description: The entry number (for example 12) or the full entry ID (for example 5-12).

get_entry_document.label: Get Entry Document
get_entry_document.description: Generates a document (PDF or Word) for an entry from one of the form's document templates.

form_id.label: Form ID
form_id.description: The form ID or internal name, as returned by "List Forms".

entry_id.label: Entry ID
entry_id.description: The entry number (for example 12) or the full entry ID (for example 5-12).

template_number.label: Template Number
template_number.description: The document template number (the first template is 1).

download_file.label: Download File
download_file.description: Downloads a file uploaded to an entry (from a File Upload or Signature field).

file_id.label: File ID
file_id.description: The "Id" of an uploaded file or a signature's PngFile from an entry.
